meta.title: What winning and losing vendors see after the award
gaps: Open the same awarded event in a second independent vendor session as Vendor A and verify that Vendor A sees it was not awarded.
Verify that Vendor B sees the purchase order after it was created.
Verify the exact awarded quantity and awarded amount rather than the event quantity and bid total exposed by the available API-value assertions.
Verify that each vendor cannot see the other vendor's price in a separate vendor session.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open the same awarded event in a second independent vendor session as Vendor A and verify that Vendor A sees it was not awarded.; Verify that Vendor B sees the purchase order after it was created.; Verify the exact awarded quantity and awarded amount rather than the event quantity and bid total exposed by the available API-value assertions.; Verify that each vendor cannot see the other vendor's price in a separate vendor session.

steps.note: Open the prepared awarded event's summary page as required for this state.
Switch to Vendor B's supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the awarded event in Vendor B's portal and remain on its overview.
Assert that the winning vendor sees the event marked as awarded.
Assert that the winning vendor's view shows the event quantity.
Assert that the winning vendor's view shows its bid total amount.

args.need: sign in as Vendor A in a second independent vendor portal session, open the same awarded event, and verify that it is not awarded and does not expose Vendor B's price

steps.note: The catalog supports only one QA vendor portal session, so the losing vendor's independent view requires tester assistance.
Confirm the resulting vendor view has no crash, server error, raw identifiers, or invalid values.
